question: Under what condition should the teacher grant the boon of long life to a disciple?
premises: The disciple must be thoroughly examined.
The teacher may then give long life.
inference: Only after careful examination should the teacher grant long life to such a person.
uncertainties: The object of giving may be the teaching or a boon; cirajīvitam suggests long life
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give him long life.
